selections.rationale: One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add a two-element accounts array with a valid first record matching accountKey and a genuine trailing absent index (a hole, not explicit undefined). applyLedgerCredit must throw TypeError before crediting, and the first input record must remain unchanged. Also check a matching first account followed by an unrelated dense malformed record. Retain safe numeric classes, all command fields, duplicate-key rejection, missing-account copied snapshots, account order and detached required fields. Do not add trim rules, numeric caps or descriptor restrictions.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. On a schedule containing one valid entry, replace with a one-hole array and require TypeError plus unchanged list and totalMinutes. Repeat replacement using a valid prefix followed by a genuine hole. Constructor input with a hole must also throw TypeError. Retain valid replacement, duplicate/dense-invalid atomicity, upsert position and append order, remove/clear, detached arguments and list records, product and sum safe-integer errors. Use tiny arrays, not allocation capacity probes.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Call handleDefect with a one-hole state and list command; require status 400, body {error:'Invalid input'}, and empty returned state. Repeat with a valid matching first record and trailing hole for get and add commands; malformed-state validation must precede dispatch and inputs remain unchanged. Retain dense-invalid-state resets versus valid-state unchanged error snapshots, sorting/status codes and mutually independent body/state records. Do not add uniqueness requirements to existing input state.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Call applyCatalogCommand with a one-hole catalog and readAll; require status 400, data {error:'Invalid input'}, and empty returned catalog. Repeat with a valid matching first item followed by a genuine hole and a read or replacement command; malformed-state precedence must hold and inputs remain unchanged. Retain five commands, replacement ID agreement and position, append/removal order, missing/duplicate status protocol and independent data/catalog records. Do not add duplicate-input-catalog rejection.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Use an otherwise valid activity with media equal to a one-hole array and require TypeError. Repeat with the hole in shared.media while the outer activity is valid. Retain empty media success, dense media order, fully detached author/media/link/count/shared snapshots, malformed values and ancestor/shared-cycle rejection. Add no recursion-depth limit, prototype restriction or new optional-present-undefined policy.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add an otherwise valid recipe with a one-hole ingredients array; awaiting add must reject TypeError, emit start then failure carrying the same rejection object, and leave get of its key null. On an existing recipe, sparse ingredients in update must reject TypeError with start/failure ordering and preserve the prior stored record. Use a genuine hole, including valid-prefix/trailing-hole coverage. Accept a whitespace-only but nonempty key and whitespace-only nonempty ingredient, preserving their exact values; continue rejecting an empty key or ingredient and a blank trimmed title. Remove duplicate-key and missing-update assertions that demand the Error not be a TypeError: require Error as specified without excluding subclasses. Retain required error identity, notifications, ignored notification return values, copy isolation and notification-throw behavior. Do not invent rollback after a success notification throws or add exception subclasses.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Remove the leading Object.getPrototypeOf(runStages).constructor.name assertion and any replacement source-spelling, constructor-name or prototype-shape checks. Retain direct behavioral validation: calling with a stages array containing a side-effect function followed by a nonfunction must not synchronously throw, must return a Promise, and must reject TypeError with zero stage invocations. Keep nonarray and genuine sparse-array Promise rejection, sequential awaits, one argument, strict callback undefined receiver, exact thrown/rejected error identity, no later invocation and array nonmutation. The immutable problem/reference still require an actual async exported function; this test-only change does not relax them.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Remove Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1 from the invalid-language RangeError list: it is a non-negative integer and no safe-integer bound is specified. With empty addresses and otherwise valid metadata, that language call must return a Promise resolving to the frozen Missing result. Retain genuinely invalid negative/fractional/NaN language Promise rejections. Add the approved metadata path: valid nonblank address and title phrase {key:' '} must return a Promise without synchronous throw and reject TypeError when awaited. localizeMeta itself remains synchronously validating, and missing/blank/nonstring address still bypasses invalid metadata. Keep repeated/unmatched substitutions, exact address/text preservation, frozen results and nonmutation; add no async reflection, dictionary-prototype, metadata-domain or exception-subtype policy.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. For each of recipientCode, crateCount and priority independently, construct an otherwise valid Object.prototype plain draft with that required property holding a valid value but non-enumerable and own. Require an invalid result, undefined value, and the corresponding field issue. Preserve accepted non-enumerable EXTRA property control. Retain required enumerable keys, trimmed recipient format, safe count boundaries, exact priorities, plain-prototype rejection, sorted unknown issues and deterministic field order, without asserting unspecified message text or broadening hidden-extra/symbol restrictions.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add UPDATE with own email:'a@b.com' and accessLevel:'' against an account whose email is a@b.com and is not excluded by currentId. Require the accessLevel format issue first, followed by the email issue with exact message 'Email is already in use'. Reverse account order and require identical issue ordering. Retain at most one format/required issue per field, CREATE/UPDATE field order, own-property behavior, current-ID exclusion, normalized uniqueness and fresh output. Do not invent exact generic format messages or new email/whitespace grammar.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Create a null-prototype palette with an actual own enumerable string data property named __proto__ whose value is 'retain'; getScheme().palette must retain own membership and that exact string. Repeat for nested rules and test that original and getter-result mutations do not affect future results. Add a non-enumerable readable own string-keyed accepted value, including nested copy coverage, and require its value to survive initial/getter copies without demanding its descriptor flags be preserved. Construct actual own data properties, not object-literal prototype setter syntax. Keep recursive validation, accepted null prototypes, insertion order and excluded symbols/inherited properties. Require no particular output prototype, extra cycle/depth policy or descriptor layout.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add empty charges with range0099-01-01 through0099-01-01 and require an empty result. Include a matching year0099 charge and require complete fresh id/accountId/day/amount fields, exact account matching, inclusive boundaries and input order. Make a valid required id non-enumerable on a matching record and check the copied id is preserved. Add a genuine trailing hole after a valid charge and require TypeError without input mutation; retain unrelated invalid-record validation. Keep leap-day and modern-calendar controls, finite nonnegative amounts, raw nonempty identifiers and detached copies. Do not introduce either acceptance or rejection tests for year0000, local-timezone parsing, a year>=100 restriction, or a new date/exception policy.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r12 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. After inserting a valid feature, amend using a code containing only a space and patch {active:false}; require Error with exact message 'Feature code must not be empty' and an unchanged snapshot. Repeat drop with a code consisting of one actual U+0009 horizontal TAB character, not the two characters backslash and t; require the same invalid-code message and unchanged snapshot. Retain nonblank missing code => 'Feature not found', duplicate insert, normalization, default true, explicit false patch, absent-field retention, ordinary string sort and snapshot independence. Add no out-of-type patch validation or explicit-undefined deletion policy.
